template:
<select id="find">SELECT #{id} AS id <where>
<if test="!test and role != 'sa'">#{id} IS NOT NULL</if>
<choose>
<when test="role == 'sa' and dto != null and dto.notOrgCode == 1">AND 1 = 0</when>
<when test="role == 'sa' and dto != null and dto.orgCode != null and dto.orgCode.length <= 6 and dto.notOrgCode == 0">AND 1 = 1</when>
<when test="dto != null and dto.orgCode != null and dto.orgCode.length > 6">AND #{dto.orgCode} IS NOT NULL</when>
</choose>
<if test="search != null and search != ''">AND #{search} IS NOT NULL</if>
<if test="userIdList != null">AND #{id} IN <foreach collection="userIdList" item="userId" open="(" close=")" separator=",">#{userId}</foreach></if>
</where></select>
